title: A New Concept of Enhancing the Anticancer Activity of Manganese Terpyridine Complex by Oxygen-Containing Substituent Modification.
authors: Li, Jiahe; Chen, Min; Jiang, Jinzhang; Huang, Jieyou; Chen, Hailan; Pan, Lixia; Nesterov, Dmytro S; Ma, Zhen; Pombeiro, Armando J L
one_liner_zh: 该文研究锰三联吡啶配合物的抗癌活性及其与DNA的嵌插结合，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作之外的DNA小分子结合和分子对接，但对象非TF-DNA体系，方法仅简单对接，与课题核心关联较弱。
abstract: Eleven manganese 4'-substituted-2,2':6',2''-terpyridine complexes (1a-1c and 2a-2h) with three non-oxygen-containing substituents (L(1a)-L(1c): phenyl, naphthalen-2-yl and naphthalen-1-yl, L(1a)-L(1c)) and eight oxygen-containing substituents (L(2a)-L(2h): 4-hydroxyl-phenyl, 3-hydroxyl-phenyl, 2-hydroxyl-phenyl, 4-methoxyl-phenyl, 4-carboxyl-phenyl, 4-(methylsulfonyl)phenyl, 4-nitrophenyl and furan-2-yl) were prepared and characterized by IR, elemental analysis or single crystal X-ray diffraction. In vitro data demonstrate that all of these show higher antiproliferative activities than cisplatin against five human carcinoma cell lines: A549, Bel-7402, Eca-109, HeLa and MCF-7. Compound 2d presents the strongest antiproliferative effect against A549 and HeLa cells, with IC(50) values being 0.281 muM and 0.356 muM, respectively. The lowest IC(50) values against Bel-7402 (0.523 muM) Eca-109 (0.514 muM) and MCF-7 (0.356 muM) were obtained for compounds 2h, 2g and 2c, respectively. Compound 2g with a nitro group showed the best results on the whole, with relevantly low IC(50) values against all the tested tumor cells. The DNA interactions with these compounds were studied by circular dichroism spectroscopic and molecular modeling methods. Spectrophotometric results revealed that the compounds have strong affinities in binding with DNA as intercalators, and the binding induces DNA conformational transition. Molecular docking studies indicate that the binding is contributed by the pi-pi stacking and hydrogen bonds. The anticancer activities of the compounds are correlated with their DNA binding ability, and the modification of oxygen-containing substituents significantly enhanced the anticancer activity, which could provide a new rationale for the future design of terpyridine-based metal complexes with antitumor potential.
abstract_zh: 制备了十一种含锰4'-取代-2,2'：6',2''-三联吡啶配合物（1a-1c和2a-2h），其中包含三种不含氧取代基（L(1a)-L(1c)：苯基、萘-2-基和萘-1-基）和八种含氧取代基（L(2a)-L(2h)：4-羟基苯基、3-羟基苯基、2-羟基苯基、4-甲氧基苯基、4-羧基苯基、4-(甲基磺酰基)苯基、4-硝基苯基和呋喃-2-基），并通过红外光谱、元素分析或单晶X射线衍射进行了表征。体外数据表明，所有这些配合物对五种人癌细胞系（A549、Bel-7402、Eca-109、HeLa和MCF-7）的抗增殖活性均高于顺铂。化合物2d对A549和HeLa细胞表现出最强的抗增殖效果，其IC(50)值分别为0.281 μM和0.356 μM。针对Bel-7402（0.523 μM）、Eca-109（0.514 μM）和MCF-7（0.356 μM）的最低IC(50)值分别由化合物2h、2g和2c获得。含有硝基的化合物2g整体表现最佳，对所有测试肿瘤细胞均具有相对较低的IC(50)值。通过圆二色光谱和分子建模方法研究了这些化合物与DNA的相互作用。分光光度结果表明，这些化合物作为嵌入剂与DNA结合具有强亲和力，且结合诱导DNA构象转变。分子对接研究表明，该结合由π-π堆积和氢键共同贡献。这些化合物的抗癌活性与其DNA结合能力相关，含氧取代基的修饰显著增强了抗癌活性，这可为未来设计具有抗肿瘤潜力的三联吡啶基金属配合物提供新的理论依据。
